title: Working at WSMB radio and the European tourism blitz
summary: Black radio of the late 1940s and his 18 years at WSMB, where he met agency people and went on a European tourism tour.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan
